messages:
Maya_CS: FYI Acadia is stuck onboarding — they enabled cert pinning in their sandbox and now their SDK init calls keep failing with 401s. I have a tiny log snippet below. Can eng take a look?

Owen_SE: Which SDK/lang and auth flow are they using? ephemeral tokens or long-lived service key?

Maya_CS: JS browser SDK + ephemeral tokens via our /session handshake. Logs show TLS+auth noise. Snippet: ```
ERROR: tls: certificate signed by unknown authority
WARN: handshake aborted, status=401, body={"error":"invalid_signature"}
```

Liam_Eng: Two quick checks: 1) cert pinning can break if they pin the wrong CA chain (especially in browser sandbox with our CDN edge certs). 2) ephemeral token rotation + preflight fanout can surface as 401s if the client refresh logic races. Do you have the full request headers (esp Authorization and x-rw-ephemeral)?

Maya_CS: Not full headers from customer yet. They said they see bursts when opening several tabs. They did paste this header snippet: `Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>` and `Origin: https://acadia.staging`

Owen_SE: Bursty fanout + strict pinning = likely TLS failures on parallel preflight connections, then fallback code tries to use old token or malformed signature. Two action items: ask Acadia to temporarily disable cert pinning (or allow our CDN cert fingerprint), and add jitter to their token refresh so not all tabs refresh simultaneously.

Sara_Support: I pulled telemetry for their account id — seeing short spike of 429s aligned with the 401 window. Suggest we tell them to add exponential backoff with random jitter on refresh, and check client clock skew > 5s. We also returned `x-rw-rate-limit` headers in the traces.

Liam_Eng: Also verify they aren't reusing a nonce incorrectly across parallel requests. In JS SDK we recommend single-flight refresh. Example handler: ```js
let refreshing = null;
async function getToken() {
  if (refreshing) return refreshing;
  refreshing = fetch('/session').then(r=>r.json()).finally(()=> refreshing = null);
  return refreshing;
}
```
This enforces one inflight refresh per tab.

Maya_CS: Good, I'll pass that snippet + the disable-pinning suggestion. Should we also prod infra to surface the client IP cert chain in the trace? That'd speed root-cause.

Liam_Eng: I'll add a lightweight trace field for the CDN cert fingerprint on the next debug build for sandbox only. Low risk.

deploy-bot: Canary for `sandbox-preflight-debug` rolled out to 5% at 2026-03-21T15:12:00Z :rocket:

Owen_SE: Plan: Maya to ask customer to disable pinning and enable single-flight refresh + jitter. Sara to watch telemetry and share any `x-rw-` headers. Liam to enable cert-fingerprint traces in sandbox canary. If 401s persist we schedule a quick call with them.

Maya_CS: I'll message Acadia now and update here. Thanks! :pray:
